{{Short description|Spline curve where each polynomial of the spline is in Hermite form}}
In the [[mathematics|mathematical]] subfield of [[numerical analysis]], a '''Hermite spline''' is a [[spline curve]] where each [[polynomial]] of the spline is in [[Hermite polynomials|Hermite form]].<ref>{{Cite book |last=Parekh |first=Ranjan |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=7XzADwAAQBAJ |title=Fundamentals of Graphics Using MATLAB |date=2019-11-26 |publisher=CRC Press |isbn=978-0-429-59173-0 |pages=53 |language=en}}</ref>
